This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 05-02-2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between Mumbai
Engineering Works Pvt Ltd, with its registered office at 22 MG Road, Mumbai ("Party A"), and Mumbai Engineering Works Pvt Ltd, with
its registered office at 22 MG Road, Chennai ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 24 months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier in accordance with
Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the purposes of this
Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by Swedish law.
